title: Conducible

inlines.v: CONDUCIBLE, adjective [Latin] Leading or tending to; having the power of conducing; having a tendency to promote or forward. Our Savior hath enjoined us a reasonable service; all his laws are in themselves conducible to the temporal interest of them that observe them. [This word is less used than conducive.]
